name: Empty state
summary: A centred icon, title, line of help and action, for a list or page with nothing in it yet.
description: Say what will appear here and give the one action that gets people started. Use it for first runs, no search results and cleared filters, each with its own wording.

classes.name: v-empty
classes.description: Centres its children in a padded column.

classes.name: v-empty-icon
classes.description: A soft tile that holds one icon.

classes.name: v-empty-title
classes.description: The short headline, in the display font.

a11y: Hide the icon tile with aria-hidden="true"; the title says it all.
If the empty state appears after a search or filter, announce it (for example inside a role="status" region) so screen reader users know the result.
Use a heading element for the title when the empty state stands in for a whole page section.

examples.title: First run
examples.html:
No invoices yet

When you send your first invoice, it shows up here.
